title: Americans’ Views of ICE Grow More Negative
summary_en: A majority of Americans (56%) now say they have an unfavorable opinion of Immigration and Customs Enforcement.
title_cn: Americans’ Views of ICE Grow More Negative

title: How Americans View Federal Agencies
summary_en: Americans view eight of 12 federal agencies we asked about more favorably than unfavorably. The National Park Service, National Weather Service and U.S. Postal Service are viewed especially positively.

title: Why Is Election Day on a Tuesday in the U.S., and How Many Other Countries Have Weekday Elections?
summary_en: The U.S. is one of 28 democratic countries that routinely holds national elections on non-holiday weekdays.
title_cn: Why Is Election Day on a Tuesday in the U.S., and How Many Other Countries Have Weekday Elections?
